verdict.rationale: Elastic documents some programmatic, UI-free operation. ES|QL queries can be run over a REST API with content negotiation via a URL parameter or HTTP headers, and Elastic Agent can run standalone inside a container. Neither is presented as a CI or headless automation workflow, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/pipeline integration, a published OpenAPI spec, headless automation guides beyond querying, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
